literal: At the very moment attachment is severed, it severs rebirth; otherwise, impermanence will be experienced.
translation: At the very moment attachment is severed, the cycle of rebirth is cut off; otherwise, one will only continue to experience the instability of existence.
modern: பற்று நீங்கிய பொழுதே பிறவி அறுக்கப்படும்; இல்லையெனில், நிலையற்ற தன்மையே தொடர்ந்து காணப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the immediate effect of renunciation on the cycle of rebirth. When all attachments are completely severed, the cause of rebirth is destroyed at that very instant. If one does not sever these attachments, they will continue to experience the painful, unstable cycle of impermanent worldly existence. The word 'kaṇṇē' emphasizes that liberation occurs simultaneously with the cessation of desire.
